findings: PARSERS (Services.qml; NotificationModel.onModelDataChanged runs parseModelData only if accept==true, else unacceptable()). Each luna subscription message is ONE object, not a list. toast: reads modelData.sourceId,message,type (dedupe), userData.id (unguarded: throws if userData missing); views read message, readable, type, iconPath, timeout (seconds), opacity, action{serviceURI,serviceMethod,launchParams}. alert: alertAction(closeAll|close|update|else create), alertInfo.timestamp (close/update key), alertInfo.modal,sourceId,title,message,readable (dedupe vs last 5), alertInfo.onFailAction; views read alertInfo.{sourceId,title,message,readable,iconUrl,thumbnailPath,modal,timeout,showTimeout,type,progress,buttons[{label,action,focus}],checkButton{id,label,value},onCloseAction}. inputAlert: alertAction(close)+alertInfo.timestamp, else clear() then append; reads alertInfo.inputs[]{portName,portIcon,action|appId,params} or alertInfo.{portName,portIcon,action|appId,params}, timeout; missing action is synthesised as luna://com.webos.applicationManager /launch {id:appId,params}. pincode: pincodePromptAction(open|close), pincodePromptInfo.timestamp (close key); views read pincodePromptInfo.{promptType,retry,title,message,appId}.

TV schemas /etc/palm/schemas/notificationmgr (read-only): createToast{sourceId,iconUrl,title,message*,readable,onclick{appId,params,target},noaction,stale,persistent,onlyToast,isSysReq,schedule.expire,type standard|light|advanced,opacity 0-1,autoTimeout 1-10,extra.images[],userData}; createAlert{iconUrl,thumbnailUrl,title,message*,readable,modal,autoTimeout 1-300,showTimeout,type confirm|warning|battery|spinner|progress,buttons*[{buttonType ok|cancel,label,onclick|onClick,params,focus}],checkButton{id,label,value},isSysReq,onclose{uri,params},onfail{uri,params}}; createInputAlert{appId,portType,portName,portIcon,deviceName,deviceIcon,params,inputs[],timeout}; createPincodePrompt{promptType*,appId,message}; closePincodePrompt{closeType*,pincode,mode}; closeAlert{alertId*}; closeToast{toastId,sourceId}; closeInputAlert{inputAlertId*}; setAlertProgress{alertId*,progress*}; closeAllAlerts; enable/disable{exceptions[]}; createSignageAlert (no schema); createNotification (persistent notification-centre entry: autoRemove,onClick,forceLcdTurnOn,needSoundPlay,soundUri,needToShowPopup,isRemoteNotification,isUnDeletable). QML ignores type battery/confirm (plain alert) and buttonType.

GATING (NotificationView.qml): acceptAlerts = access.alerts && !powerSuspending && !isOsdDisplayOff. acceptAdvancedAlerts = inputPopups(always true, no setter) && access.alerts && !powerOnlyMode && !substrateMode && !powerSuspending && !isOsdDisplayOff && !(modalAlertActive && alertCount). acceptToasts = access.toasts && !powerSuspending && !isOsdDisplayOff && (isAtelier || ui!=='partial'). acceptPincodePrompts = access.pincodePrompts && !powerSuspending && !isOsdDisplayOff && !(modalAlertActive && alertCount). Dropped items are forgotten; a rejected alert fires its onFailAction (luna call), a rejected PIN 'open' is answered with /closePincodePrompt{closeType:close}. access.* come from the foreground window's _WEBOS_ACCESS_POLICY_ALERTS/TOASTS/PINCODEPROMPTS (default true; restricted window type -> alerts/toasts false unless set, PIN true). isOsdDisplayOff = hotelMode tvlinkOsdDisplay=='off'. powerSuspending from tvpower getPowerState. Also: isPowerOffCheck (tvpower 'request always on display' + reason remoteKey) -> when sub state becomes 'always on display' a modal type=warning alert triggers tvpower/power2/powerOff{reason:remoteKey}. High contrast (settingsservice option/highContrast != off): alert card black, opaque, light text. Orientation (msc getOrientationInfo) rotates/swaps views for portrait sets; irrelevant here.

DEFAULTS/TIMEOUTS (ms): toast 5000 (autoTimeout*1000 if given); toast hover pauses timer, hard cap 15000 (closingMasterTimer); a queued toast replaces the visible one 2000 after being queued; toastModelMaxCount=1, nextToastList unbounded; identical (sourceId,message,type) to the visible toast -> timer restart only, to a queued one -> dropped. Alert: no timer unless alertInfo.timeout>0 (autoTimeout*1000); timer restarts on every button focus change; onclose action runs on removal unless a button was pressed; user inactivity (screensaver userActivityExpired) closes alerts incl. modal. Duplicate alerts (same modal+sourceId+title+message+readable among last 5) -> older removed. Modal alerts insert before the first non-modal, else append. Max simultaneous: toast 1; alerts unbounded but only the top one is focused/sized (z: modal -index, non-modal -10000-index); input alert 1 (clear on new); PIN appended. PIN: forced close when retry reaches 3; focus jumps to OK after 4 digits; arrow multi-tap timer 1000.

ANIMATIONS: notification fade 300ms (Notification.qml); toast slide 400ms OutBack (y from bottom; light toast from top); toast link click 50+20+50ms; PIN stack slide 400ms OutBack; alert has no slide (300ms opacity only); advanced alert in: 330ms + 115ms bounce (60px), out: shrink 134ms after 130ms pause, activate path slides down 115+330ms then fires the action; card focus fades 300/200ms; button focus 100ms scale 1.05; progress width 200ms; spinner 1300ms/turn. Z-order: PIN 10001, alert 10002, advanced scrim 10003 (0.6 black), advanced alert 10004, 10005 reserved for voice agent, toast 10006.

CONTRACT A REPLACEMENT MUST KEEP: (1) alert button click = luna call made AS THE SOURCE APP via callForApplication(sourceId, serviceURI, serviceMethod, launchParams), not as surfacemanager; toast/input-alert actions and onfail/onclose use a plain call. (2) createAlert returns alertId; callers close with closeAlert{alertId}; the service pushes alertAction close/update with timestamp. (3) PIN: digits go back via /closePincodePrompt{closeType:relay,pincode,mode,appId}; notificationmgr validates and replies to the createPincodePrompt caller {matched}; Cancel/Back-at-empty/3 retries = {closeType:close}; PIN open closes non-modal alert, alert open closes PIN, modal alert closes advanced alert. (4) Back (on release) closes non-modal alert + advanced alert (systemUi.js 891, easytv.js 59); modal alert swallows Back/Home/Recent/local keys; PIN receives Back as backspace. (5) Home, app launch, closeCompositorItems and closeAllSystemUI close alert, advanced alert, PIN (toast only with includeToast). (6) Alert focus: first button or button.focus=true; Up/Down between buttons; Return activates. (7) Compositor itself serves luna method surfacemanager/alertChoice, used as a button callback by the zoom/senior-TV alert. (8) getCurrentHomeUIState reports toast/inputAlert/alert/pincodePrompt; nudge is suppressed while alert/PIN/advanced alert show.

TTS/VOICE: tts luna://com.webos.service.tts/speak only when option/audioGuidance=='on' and not (navigation speech while pointer visible). Toast speaks readable||message at general level immediately. Alert speaks title+message/readable+all button labels on focus (type 'title' chain, 40ms debounce); each button speaks '

THIS SET (TV getConfigs, read-only): rollingscreen supportScreenType='none', authenticationMethods.pincode=['keyboardMode'] (no secureMode), ratingSetting.password=false, supportBNO=false -> partial-view variants, Atelier sizes, secure arrow-pad PIN, PIN tooltip and the advanced-card X (partial only) are unreachable; PIN is always full-screen (delegate hard-codes isFullType=true, so PIN X and secure button are hidden). Shipping UI is SystemUI/Notification; WebOSCompositorBase/views/notification is used only by the base ViewsRoot (StarfishViewsRoot overrides it). Alert closeButton is visible:false. toast_close/toast_link/m_toast_bg/clear_f PNGs and alert body_bg/top/left/right/bottom PNGs are mapped in NotificationStyle but never drawn; pinprompt_box_* PNGs load into an invisible Image (boxes are Rectangles). All PIN messages render in red (#FB5656).

CALLERS in /tmp/tvsrc (regex call-site counts, wrapper level; web/JS bundles and native services not included, so lower bounds). createToast: livemenu(19), dvrpopup(18), tvhotkey(17), apiadapter(4), familycare(2), inputcommon(2), voice(1), assistant(1). createAlert: livemenu(11), tvhotkey(5), secondscreen.gateway(4: pairing Yes/No, PIN warning, cancel), apiadapter.pub(2, passthrough for web apps), inputcommon(1), dvrpopup(1), voice(1), assistant(1), universalqcard(1), familycare(1). closeAlert: livemenu(2), apiadapter(2), tvhotkey/dvrpopup/voice/assistant/secondscreen.gateway(1 each). closeToast: apiadapter(2). createPincodePrompt: livemenu(3: DetailPopup, RelatedContents, wrapper; promptType parental), inputcommon(1, screensaver/blocked-state unlock), tvhotkey(1)/dvrpopup(1) wrappers without caller. createInputAlert: tvhotkey(1)/dvrpopup(1) wrappers only, never called; no creator found locally. createPopup: only secondscreen pairing-manager's own method (it calls createAlert). checkButton: no caller anywhere. type=warning: tvhotkey CustomerSupport, secondscreen PIN. setAlertProgress/closeAllAlerts/createSignageAlert/createNotification/closeInputAlert: no caller in /tmp/tvsrc.

CALLERS in compositor QML/JS (uiinv): createToast: KeyFilters/appLaunch.js(47: 'not supported/available', network, Alexa/Google/Alice messages), preProcess.js(4), systemUi.js(3), StarfishMagicNumber(6), Toolbar(2), ServerDecoration(2), StarfishKeyFilter/ViewStateController/FullscreenView/ViewAdjustments(1 each), QuickSettings(6), ScreenRemote(5), InputPicker(4), SportsAlarm(2), StoreStreamer(1), FavoriteChannels(2 bindings), RemoteUserList(1 + closeToast). createAlert: appLaunch.js(2: local-key power-off warning alerts), systemUi.js(1: 'Do you want to exit the app?' Exit/Cancel, non-modal, on Back/Close key at app root), StarfishKeyFilter(2: AV-reset modal Yes/No), StarfishMagicNumber(1: register app to number key), ViewAdjustments(2: zoom pointer/colour inversion), ExtendedLunaServiceAPI(1), QuickSettings(6), InputPicker(3), ScreenRemote/SportsAlarm/StoreStreamer(1 each), FavoriteChannels(1 binding). closeAlert: QuickSettings(2), KeyFilter avReset(1), ScreenRemote/SportsAlarm/StoreStreamer(1 each). createInputAlert: InputPicker wrapper only.

IMAGES: SystemUI/Notification/images/alert/* (18) = 9-slice shadow_* drawn by MoonstoneShadow (the non-shadow body_bg/top/left/right/bottom_* are unused); check_box_icon_l/s = alert checkbox tick; pinprompt_box_* / box_dot_* = PIN boxes (loaded, invisible); pinprompt_btn_close_* = PIN X (hidden in full); pinprompt_number_box_delete_* = unused back button; pinprompt_help_image = secure arrow-pad help; pin_locked/unlocked* = secure toggle; tooltip-* = PIN tooltip nubs; toast_close/toast_link/m_toast_bg_*/clear_f = declared, unused; partialview/* = rolling-screen PIN + advanced-alert variant (home_menu_music unused). SystemUIAssets/images: volume_*, list_action_*, icon_close, icon_nav_left_slash, default_app_splash, magic_number_channel_icon = volume OSD and other compositor art, not notification. Toast/alert icons come from caller iconUrl at runtime.

NOTES: 'popup' is not a notification type (Popup.qml is a base class). 'Selectable lists' do not exist here (Selectable.qml is the pointer/OK-key base of buttons). The persistent notification centre is a separate app (com.webos.app.notificationcenter) fed by createNotification / createToast persistent. Queueing, default timeouts, type defaults and PIN validation (incl. FRA/BEL '0000' ban, config.json UnacceptablePincode) live in native /usr/sbin/notificationmgr, so a QML-only replacement must keep that daemon or re-implement its luna API. TV was only read via getConfigs and schema/config cat; one late scan job was cancelled on request.
